name: INSID3
plain: INSID3 (2026): finds the object shown in one or more example images with masks in a new image, without training, from Meta's DINOv3 features. Apache-2.0 code; the DINOv3 weights are under the gated DINOv3 licence.
summary: INSID3 (2026): training-free in-context segmentation. Reference images with masks -> the same concept in a target image, from frozen DINOv3 ViT-L patch features (positional debiasing, forward / backward matching, average-linkage clustering of the target patches). The backbone is fastforks' DINOv3 (`features`), the clustering runs on the GPU. The portable `module()` is the backbone only.

papers.title: INSID3: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with DINOv3

licence_notes: The INSID3 code is Apache-2.0; it ships no weights of its own and runs the DINOv3 ViT-L/16 checkpoint, which is under the DINOv3 License (Meta: attribution and conditions apply; gated on Hugging Face); read it before commercial use.
task_io: Input: one image plus a point, box or text prompt. Output: masks with quality scores.

variants.name: insid3-vitl16

licence.training_note: training-free; the DINOv3 backbone: LVD-1689M (1.689B curated Instagram images, self-supervised), not released

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized inside to the fixed encoder input 1024x1024 (the default export size)

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original32.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original32.note: visinf/INSID3@0c165a10cf52 set_reference + set_target + segment, its encoder autocast off

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); visinf/INSID3@0c165a10cf52 set_reference + set_target + segment, bf16 autocast (as shipped)

quality.title: COCO val2017, one-shot episodes (3 per class), class mIoU %
quality.protocol: In-context: per COCO class 3 (reference, target) pairs drawn with seed 0 from the images whose class covers >= 2 %, the class's non-crowd instances as one mask; foreground IoU summed per class, mean over the 80 classes.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.002 and p99 <= 0.005 (absolute error of the output `similarity`).
